description: YAML rule loader and Markdown skill retriever for V4 investigation harness governance

acceptance_criteria.description: GovernanceRule dataclass with fields: id (str), enforcement (Literal['hard','soft']), stage (Literal['planning','examination','attribution','all']), description (str), check (str | None), prompt_text (str). Invalid enforcement or stage values raise ValueError on construction.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: construct from valid dict; assert all fields; assert ValueError for enforcement='maybe' and stage='invalid'

acceptance_criteria.description: load_rules(stage, rules_dir=None) → tuple[list[GovernanceRule], list[GovernanceRule]] as (hard_rules, soft_rules). Includes rules where rule.stage == stage OR rule.stage == 'all'. Default rules_dir=data/governance/rules/.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test against seed files: load_rules('attribution') returns only min_suspects (hard); load_rules('examination') returns parent_chain_examine (soft) + continue_below_confidence (hard); load_rules('planning') returns ([], [])

acceptance_criteria.description: Hard/soft partition is exhaustive and exclusive: every loaded rule appears in exactly one of hard_rules or soft_rules based on enforcement field.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: len(hard)+len(soft) == total matched; hard all enforcement=hard; soft all enforcement=soft; no overlap by id

acceptance_criteria.description: RuleViolation dataclass with fields: rule_id (str), message (str), context (dict). HardRuleRegistry.register(rule_id, check_fn) and check_all(stage, context) → list[RuleViolation] invoking registered check_fns for hard rules at stage.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: register stub for min_suspects returning one violation; check_all('attribution', ctx) returns it; unregistered hard rules skipped without error

acceptance_criteria.description: HardRuleRegistry includes stub check implementations registered by default for min_suspects and continue_below_confidence. Stubs read context keys suspects/candidate_set/top_confidence/confidence_gate/budget_hard_stop and return violations when check condition fails.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: min_suspects stub returns violation when len(suspects)<3 and len(candidate_set)>=3; continue_below_confidence stub returns violation when top_confidence<gate and not budget_hard_stop

acceptance_criteria.description: GovernanceSkill dataclass with fields: id (str), scope (Literal['project','general']), project (str | None), triggers (list[str]), source (Literal['manual','trace-derived']), trace_ref (str), body (str — markdown after frontmatter). scope=project requires non-empty project.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: parse spark_serde_blame and npe_null_check_removal seed files; assert all fields including body non-empty; ValueError when scope=project and project empty

acceptance_criteria.description: retrieve_skills(problem_statement, top_k=3, skills_dir=None) → list[tuple[GovernanceSkill, int]] ranked by score descending. score = len({t.lower() for t in triggers} ∩ {k.lower() for k in problem_statement.extracted_keywords}); include only score > 0. Default skills_dir=data/governance/skills/ (excludes skills/drafts/ subtree).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: ProblemStatement(project='SPARK', keywords=['serialization','kryo']) returns spark_serde_blame with score 2 as first result

acceptance_criteria.description: retrieve_skills scope filter: project-scoped skills included only when problem_statement.project equals skill.project (case-insensitive). general-scoped skills match any project when triggers overlap.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: SPARK skill not returned for GROOVY project even when keywords match; general npe skill returned for GROOVY when NPE keywords match

acceptance_criteria.description: retrieve_skills tie-breaking: on equal score, project-scoped skills rank before general-scoped skills; stable order by skill id when still tied.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: fixture with project and general skill sharing one trigger keyword — project skill ranks first

acceptance_criteria.description: Loaders parse committed seed governance artifacts without modification: 3 YAML rules + 2 active MD skills at data/governance/ match ADR field values (enforcement, stage, triggers, scope, source, trace_ref).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Integration test: load seed dirs; assert rule ids {min_suspects, parent_chain_examine, continue_below_confidence}; assert skill ids {spark_serde_blame, npe_null_check_removal}; parent_chain_examine.check is None

acceptance_criteria.description: governance/__init__.py exports: GovernanceRule, GovernanceSkill, RuleViolation, load_rules, retrieve_skills, HardRuleRegistry
acceptance_criteria.verification: Import test: from commit_investigator.governance import all seven names

acceptance_criteria.description: Package isolation: governance imports only from commit_investigator.extraction (ProblemStatement) and stdlib/third-party (yaml). Zero imports from agent/, eval/, infra/, or models/.
pyyaml listed in pyproject.toml [project].dependencies (package name pyyaml, import yaml).
acceptance_criteria.verification: pyproject.toml dependencies include pyyaml; python -c 'import yaml' succeeds in project venv

acceptance_criteria.description: tests/test_governance.py covers all ACs and edge cases; pytest tests/ passes with zero regressions (188+ existing tests).
acceptance_criteria.verification: pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/_v2_archive exits 0; test_governance.py exists with ≥15 tests

acceptance_criteria.description: Each module file under src/commit_investigator/governance/ ≤ 300 lines.
acceptance_criteria.verification: wc -l on all .py files in governance package

edge_cases.description: load_rules('planning') against seed data returns empty hard and soft lists
Rule with stage='all' is returned for every load_rules(stage) call
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: tmp rules dir with stage=all rule; load_rules('examination') and load_rules('attribution') both include it

edge_cases.description: retrieve_skills returns [] when no keyword overlap (score=0 for all skills)
retrieve_skills ignores skills/drafts/ even when draft file has matching triggers
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: draft skill in tmp skills/drafts/ with matching keywords not returned

edge_cases.description: Malformed YAML rule file skipped with warning logged; other valid rules still load
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: tmp dir with one bad.yaml + one valid.yaml; caplog/warning assert; valid rule loaded

edge_cases.description: Malformed skill markdown (missing/invalid frontmatter) skipped with warning; valid skills still load
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: tmp dir with broken.md + valid.md; warning logged; valid skill returned

edge_cases.description: Empty rules_dir and skills_dir return empty results without error
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: load_rules('examination', rules_dir=empty_tmp) → ([],[]); retrieve_skills(..., skills_dir=empty_tmp) → []

edge_cases.description: Keyword matching is case-insensitive: trigger 'Kryo' matches extracted keyword 'kryo'
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: case-variant keywords produce score ≥ 1

out_of_scope: Q1 conflict-resolution precedence at harness transitions (v4-investigation-harness task)
Skill draft writer from traces (future harness task)
Composite trigger 'project + keyword' beyond seed file triggers (spark_serde_blame uses keyword list only)
verification_method: pytest tests/test_governance.py tests/ + grep import isolation + wc -l file sizing + ReadLints on src/commit_investigator/governance/
